Ari (CSM): Heads-up: NorthBridge (mid-market) stalled during onboarding step 3. Weekly active seats down 33%. Renewal ~5w.
Ben (AM): Any error spikes or exec silence?
Ari (CSM): Devs hit repeated 429s during bulk ingest, confusion about model pinning. NPS 5 last check. Exec still engaged but terse.
Sofia (Success Eng): I can run a 15-min diag: check KV cache, batch windows, tail lat traces. Could be client-side batching misconfig.
Noah (PS): I'll prep a short "get to step 4" workshop (20m): config checklist, rollback steps, quick sample script. Recommend 1h free PS + $800 credit.
Ben (AM): Approve. Aim outreach within 48h and session within 72h. Ari, draft message and timeline.
Ari (CSM): Draft outreach:
"Hi [Name], we saw onboarding friction and low activity. Can we do a 20-30m workshop this week to clear integration steps? We'll include a short diagnostics pass, 1h PS, and a $800 credit to help unblock. -Ari"
Sofia (Success Eng): I'll attach a pre-call checklist link (internal). Noah: can you assemble rollback play and success criteria?
Noah (PS): Success criteria: 1) no 429s for 48h post-fix, 2) integration tests green, 3) seat activity +15% in 7 days. If fail, escalate to retention pod and draft downgrade mapping.
ops-bot: Reminder set for metrics check in 8 days (1899996851).
Ari (CSM): Outreach sent 08:30, session booked Thursday 15:00. Will update after call. :rocket:
